children.name: cTitle
children.content:
Customize, upgrade,
repair: The choice is yours

children.name: cSub
children.content: Standardize devices that can be upgraded and repaired in-house. Reduce e-waste and total cost of ownership.
Configure your laptop the way you work. Upgrade and repair when your needs evolve over time.
Scale up performance with modular options. Keep devices in service with easy parts replacement.
Compact desktop power with maintainable internals. Built for long-term fleet reliability.
Choose ports and modules for each role. Swap and customize without replacing the whole device.

children.name: t1q
children.content: "The laptops were exactly what we needed for developers and design teams."

children.name: t2q
children.content: "Framework systems simplified IT support and helped reduce e-waste over time."

children.name: t3q
children.content: "The modular approach gives us confidence that these systems can adapt with our teams."
Framework offers a unique approach to supporting IT budgets by keeping devices in service longer through modular upgrades and repairability.
Framework supports multiple operating systems with enterprise-ready flexibility for Windows and Linux deployments.
